## Tasks

1. Determine which phase of the project roadmap needs to be implemented next based on the current progress and completed phases.
2. Review the project roadmap documentation to understand the goals, deliverables, and timelines associated with the identified phase.
3. Create a detailed task description for implementing the identified phase, including:
   - A clear explanation of the objectives for the phase.
   - The specific deliverables that need to be produced.
   - References to any relevant documentation or resources.
   - Success criteria to determine when the phase has been successfully implemented.
4. Use sub-agents to implement the tasks outlined in the phase, ensuring that each sub-agent has a clear understanding of their responsibilities.
5. Monitor the progress of each sub-agent, providing guidance and support as needed to ensure that the work stays on track.
6. Upon completion of the phase, conduct a thorough review to ensure that all deliverables meet the defined success criteria.
7. Document the implementation process, including any challenges faced and how they were overcome, to inform future phases of the project.

## Notes
- Use sub-agents effectively to distribute workload and leverage specialized skills.
- Regularly communicate with sub-agents to track progress and address any issues promptly.
- Use all the tools at your disposal to facilitate efficient task management and execution; encourage sub-agents to utilize these tools as well.
- Use clear and concise communication when assigning tasks to sub-agents.
